headline: EU Extends Military Mission in Mozambique Gas Region Through 2028
summary: The European Union extended its military assistance mission in Mozambique by two years through December 31, 2028, maintaining security support in the gas-rich Cabo Delgado province.
why: Securing natural gas extraction regions in Mozambique is vital for prospective liquefied natural gas supply projects destined for European markets.

impacts.name: Mozambique
impacts.why: Security support helps protect critical gas extraction infrastructure in northern provinces.
